name: Siren Head : The Forest
desc:
Siren Head hunts the forest at night, and he hears everything. Leave the bunker, scavenge scrap and sell it at the shop to gear up. Blind him with strobe lights and fight back with rockets and guns, or play as Siren Head and hunt down other players yourself.

How long can you survive?

🏆 Top the leaderboard for Longest Time Alive
❤️ Join the group for a FREE revive

Controls:
Sprint - Shift / L3
Crouch - C / B
Interact - E / X
Reload - R / X
Hotbar - 1-6 / LB & RB
Use - Left Click / RT
Alt Use - Right Click / LT

Siren Head was created by Trevor Henderson. Inspired by The Rake and Cult of the Cryptids.
